votes.evidence: src/listing/index.ts:18 defines SECRET_KEY = /secret|token|password|passwd|authorization|api[-_]?key|credential|cookie|.../. It does not match 'privateKey' or 'x-auth'. dumpValue recurses into arrays without any key/flag check, so '--api-key <v>' and '--auth=<v>' inside args are kept. The describeListing docstring promises that credential-named values are removed. Repro with the given .mcp.json and --plugin-dir --verbose: stderr contained PRIVKEYVALUE123456, XAUTHVALUE98765, Zq8vLmN3pRt5WxY2 and Zq8vLmN3pRt5WxY2b verbatim.
